title: Energy Overhead in Sensor Nodes: Embedded Machine Learning and Data Offloading via Low Power Wide Area Networks
abstract: arXiv:2510.24829v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Image- and audio-based remote IoT applications offer a substantial opportunity to address ecological changes. However, to be effective, they must operate for long periods on limited power while also providing data via LPWAN. Previous studies have investigated the energy efficiency of isolated components such as radio transmission or data processing methods within an IoT system. However, a holistic evaluation is required to determine the main drivers of energy consumption in sensor nodes. To address this, we systematically analyze energy consumption across the entire sensor-node pipeline, from data acquisition to optional on-device CNN classification and wireless network transmission, using an ESP32-S3 microcontroller. We compare on-device CNN classification followed by result transmission with transmitting raw sensor data across three environmental monitoring scenarios. translated_title: 传感器节点中的能耗开销：嵌入式机器学习与通过低功耗广域网络的数据卸载
translated_abstract: 基于图像和音频的远程物联网应用为应对生态变化提供了巨大的机遇。然而，要使其有效运作，这些应用必须在有限电力供应下长时间运行，同时通过低功耗广域网络（LPWAN）提供数据。以往的研究只考察了物联网系统中孤立组件的能效，例如无线电传输或数据处理方法。然而，要确定传感器节点能耗的主要驱动因素，需要进行整体性的评估。为解决这一问题，我们以ESP32-S3微控制器为平台，系统地分析了传感器节点从数据采集、可选的设备端CNN分类到无线网络传输的整个流程中的能耗。我们在三个环境监测场景中，比较了先在设备端进行CNN分类再传输结果与直接传输原始传感器数据这两种方案。在此基础上，我们改变了开发者可控的变量，特别是……
tldr: 本研究以ESP32-S3为平台，对传感器节点从数据采集、设备端CNN推理到LPWAN无线传输的完整流程进行了系统能耗分析，通过比较本地分类后传输结果与直接卸载原始数据两种方案，揭示了传感器节点能耗的主要驱动因素。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes energy consumption across the entire sensor-node pipeline—from data acquisition to optional on-device CNN inference and LPWAN transmission—comparing embedded machine learning with raw data offloading across three environmental monitoring scenarios to identify the main drivers of energy consumption in IoT sensor nodes.
